$ GC DIST = geocentric distance
$ GC LAT = geocentric latitude
$ LONG = longitude
$
$ EF VEL = magnitude of the earth-fixed velocity vector
$ VEL-AZ = velocity of the system in terms of azimuth
$ VEL-EL = velocity in terms of elevation
$
$ HEAD = velocity in terms of heading angle
$ FLT-PATH = velocity in terms of flight path angle
$ SF VEL = magnitude of the space-fixed velocity vector
$
$ ALTITUDE = Perpendicular distance from vehicle centre of gravity to
$     Fischer Ellipsoid, positive above Fishcer Ellipsoid
$
$ RANGE = Surface range measured along Fischer Ellipsoid form the launch
$     site to the subvehicle point
$
$ TIME = Range time, reference to nearest integer second before IU
$     umbilical disconnect
